# PromptVault

> PromptVault is an open-source library of AI-generated image examples paired with copy-ready prompt text, model context, visual style, and aspect ratio.

Replace `https://your-domain.example` with your deployed site URL.

Canonical site: https://your-domain.example/
XML sitemap: https://your-domain.example/sitemap.xml
Human-readable sitemap: https://your-domain.example/sitemap-html

## Primary sections

- [Explore prompts](https://your-domain.example/explore): Interactive prompt browser.
- [Prompt topics](https://your-domain.example/prompts): Crawlable model and visual-style hubs.
- [Trending prompts](https://your-domain.example/trending): Popular prompt examples.
- [Collections](https://your-domain.example/collections): Editorially curated prompt sets.
- [Blog](https://your-domain.example/blog): Prompt-engineering tutorials, comparisons, and practical guides.
- [About](https://your-domain.example/about): Mission and editorial approach.
- [Terms and prompt license](https://your-domain.example/terms#prompt-license): Usage and licensing information.

## Content conventions

- Prompt detail URLs use `/prompt/{descriptive-slug}`.
- Topic hubs use `/prompts/engine/{model-slug}` and `/prompts/style/{style-slug}`.
- Blog articles use `/blog/{article-slug}`.
- Prompt pages identify the prompt text, model, visual category, aspect ratio, and example image when available.
- Blog pages may include a summary, visible FAQs, author information, citations, related articles, and relevant prompt examples.

## Crawler policy

Search and answer-engine crawlers named in robots.txt may crawl public content. Private account, administrator, and API paths are excluded. Training-only crawlers listed as disallowed in robots.txt must not crawl the site.
